title: Underground Work Risk Assessment

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Pre-Start Checks

☐ Underground work method statement and rescue plan approved

☐ Permit to enter issued and atmosphere tested before every entry

☐ Entry / exit log and head count system in place

☐ Competent supervisor and trained attendant at the entry point

☐ Emergency communication tested

☐ Workers trained in confined space entry and emergency escape
